commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== STATUS ==='
git status --short --branch
echo
echo '=== MEDIA CALLERS ==='
git grep -n -E 'publish_image_derivatives|store_image_bytes|delete_public_image|public_storage_path' -- backend scripts frontend || true
echo
echo '=== PUBLIC_PATH ASSUMPTIONS ==='
git grep -n -E 'public_path.*media|/media/|removeprefix\("/media/"\)|startswith\("/media/"\)' -- backend scripts frontend docs AGENTS.md || true
echo
echo '=== PHOTO ROUTES / SERIALIZERS / REVIEW ==='
sed -n '1,240p' backend/app/api/routes/photos.py
sed -n '1,220p' backend/app/serializers/photo.py
sed -n '1,260p' backend/app/services/photo_uploads.py
sed -n '1,220p' backend/app/services/review.py
echo
echo '=== RETENTION / REDACTION / DIAGNOSTICS ==='
sed -n '1,280p' backend/app/services/private_original_retention.py
sed -n '1,320p' backend/app/services/media/redaction.py
git grep -n -E 'photo.*public_path|public_path.*photo|Public photo|public derivative' -- backend/app/services/local_data_diagnostics* backend/app/tests scripts || true
echo
echo '=== RELEVANT TEST FILES ==='
find backend/app/tests -type f | sort | grep -E 'photo|media|retention|redaction|place' | head -n 120
